the_bug_this_shape_found_that_the_databa.symptom: execute_compiled_steps returned ok:True and the file in the new environment was MISSING
the_bug_this_shape_found_that_the_databa.cause: the demonstrated ABSOLUTE PATH was baked into the instantiated step; nothing rebased it
the_bug_this_shape_found_that_the_databa.why_sqlite_never_showed_it: the recorded db_path was also absolute, and the test that exercises it reuses the same database
the_bug_this_shape_found_that_the_databa.significance: a skill that cannot move to a new directory is not a skill in a new environment, it is a recording of an old one. THIS IS NOT AN ABSTRACTION TEST -- it is the definition of the claim.

state_of_the_abstraction_claim.verdict: two of the declared shapes now work end to end. The abstraction is supported, not proven: two points do not determine a curve.
